CustomField.description: The tracking id that was live when this chain was launched: the parent run's id when a step launched it, otherwise the launching action's id. Empty for a chain launched with no tracking id, and for a restart.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The tracking id this chain was launched under: the parent run when a step launched it, otherwise the action that launched it. Empty when the chain started its own action, and for a restart.
CustomField.label: Launched Under
